# proxmox_node_tasks (Data Source)

Lists tasks of a node from `/nodes/{node}/tasks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_tasks" "t" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  limit = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries, default 100.

### Read-Only

- `tasks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `endtime` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `starttime` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `upid` (String)
- `user` (String)
